blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists can expect a substantial reduction in fuel prices this week, with gasoline prices set to plunge by nearly P17 per liter. Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary Sharon Garin said during a media briefing that gasoline prices would drop by at least P16.80 per liter beginning Nov. 10. This marks the first time gasoline logged a double-digit decrease since the Middle East war began.
